verdict.rationale: Gusto's own announcement says users can connect through Gusto's MCP server and link Gusto to Claude, ChatGPT and other AI tools to query payroll, prep payroll and generate reports. It also describes a Multi-Client MCP for accounting firms and owner approval of every agent change. All of this comes from press-release claims, not technical documentation. missing for 10: MCP setup/auth documentation, a list of exposed tools and operations, independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described.
